headline: China Services Sector Growth Slows to Three-Month Low
summary: Growth in China's services sector decelerated to a three-month low, with new businesses continuing to grow at a rate virtually unchanged from September.
why: China's services PMI and growth metrics serve as key indicators for the health of the world's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Deceleration in services growth points to moderating domestic economic momentum.
